files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)

from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import recall_score, precision_score

models = {
    "logistic": make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)),
    "forest": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=0),
    "svm": make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), SVC()),
}
for name, m in models.items():
    cv = cross_val_score(m, X_train, y_train, cv=5, scoring="recall")
    print(name, "CV recall:", cv.mean().round(3))

best = models["logistic"].fit(X_train, y_train)
pred = best.predict(X_test)
print("test recall:", round(recall_score(y_test, pred), 3),
      "precision:", round(precision_score(y_test, pred), 3))

prompt.en: Compare 3 models (logistic, forest, svm) with cross_val_score(cv=5, scoring='recall') on the train set. Assign results as a dictionary {name: mean_recall} and best_name as the best model's name.

from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

models = {
    "logistic": make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)),
    "forest": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=0),
    "svm": make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), SVC()),
}
results = {name: cross_val_score(m, X_train, y_train, cv=5, scoring="recall").mean() for name, m in models.items()}
best_name = max(results, key=results.get)
print({k: round(v, 3) for k, v in results.items()}, best_name)

solution.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import recall_score, precision_score

best = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))
best.fit(X_train, y_train)
pred = best.predict(X_test)
test_recall = recall_score(y_test, pred)
test_precision = precision_score(y_test, pred)
print(round(test_recall, 3), round(test_precision, 3))
